name: Abaxx Technologies Inc.
summary: Abaxx Technologies Inc., engages in developing software tools which enable commodity traders and finance professionals to communicate, trade, and transact in Canada. The company offers Abaxx Spot, a smarter markets for physical gold trading; Adaptive Infrastructure, a smarter market infrastructure to provide a unified custodial foundation across regulated and privately negotiated markets; MarketOS, an integrated console suite that helps to identity, communication, documentation, and agreement workflows for institutional markets; and Abaxx Digital Title, a re-engineering tokenization.
